But typical classification: "重大责任事故" is for major accidents causing death, serious injury, property loss, etc., due to violation of safety regulations in production, construction, transportation, etc. So could be applicable.

But we need to choose from list. The most precise is "过失致人死亡". The example list includes that label. So answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>
